description: This file defines API functions for interacting with a notes backend service, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting notes. It handles HTTP requests and responses, utilizing fetch and environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the API base URL, either from environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL or a default localhost URL, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: requestJson(path, { method = "GET", body, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a JSON HTTP request with fetch, handling various HTTP methods, request body, error handling, and parsing JSON responses.

methods.name: listNotes({ signal } = {})
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of notes from the backend service.

methods.name: createNote({ title, content }, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content.

methods.name: updateNote(noteId, { title, content }, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by noteId with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote(noteId, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by noteId.

ctags.name: createNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createNote({ title, content }, { signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: updateNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateNote(noteId, { title, content }, { signal } = {}) {$/
